text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A heat spreading from within... Is this, 
strength?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Soon, like a crown adorning my head... It 
shall be a light befitting my path to 
supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...We commend you. You should take pride 
in presenting this tribute to Us."
